name: Wanderburg — Hybrid 2.5D
description: CONVERSION TARGET. An orthographic top-down lens with the shading model switched off (the flat preset: no toon bands, no ink; sun and sky still come from the biome). The world stays the 3D height field — see environment — so what this shows today is the valley from directly above, not sprite art: a real 2.5D presentation needs billboard sprites for the roles in GAME_SPEC.assets (skill asset-representation, tools/placeholder.mjs). Every entity is SELF-PRESENTED (GAME_SPEC.entities declare representation "none"): js/WanderView.js + js/WanderMesh.js build the meshes on the kit engine layer, so the pipeline binds no second copy of anything.
